title: Algebra of Feeling — verification core (v0.3.2)
description: Machine-checked verification core for the “Algebra of Feeling” preprint, version 0.3.2. Contains the RCDA Lean 4 formalisation (853 declarations, 396 theorems, 49 catalogued claims; foundational axioms Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext only — no project axioms), the C++23 realisation of the Cayley–Dickson product and Bloch binding, and the Sounio comparator that checks the two implementations against each other field by field (115/115 fields agree at a tolerance of 1e-9; the one residual deviation of 2.8e-17 is explained by s = 9/10 not being exactly representable in binary floating point). Calculation follows ADR009 (C++23, F#, F*, Futhark or Koka); theorems are proved and machine-checked in Lean 4. The manuscript text (pt/en) and figures are not included in this repository.
